plan.classification: Isolated private expert-bank layout; identical native binary,Q8 MTP,cache/scratch placement and request bodies.
plan.prerequisites: Both packed-bank117K diagnostic processes pass with conserved MoE work,fewer requested H2D bytes,closed ownership,full before/after model hashes and no fresh fault. Verify same-build engine,nine fixtures,original inputs and all runtime/model identities.
plan.decision: Compare first-use separately. For each pair use the ratio of subsequent-request median throughput (three fresh requests/process). Faster screen requires all three ratios>1 and geomean>1.02; slower screen requires all<1 and geomean<1/1.02. Otherwise inconclusive. Nonregression requires geomean>=0.98 and every pair>=0.95. The1000 milestone requires each of three candidate process medians>=1000tok/s.
plan.stopping: Stop on first process, input, route, fault, ownership, budget or sample-eligibility failure. Never retry a root or replace failed samples. No speed-based early stopping.
plan.limits: Independent process pairs are repetition units. Four requests share each process; first-long and subsequent-long results remain separate. Short thinking output does not qualify decode,task quality,agent-session or physical262144/session/RESTORE. Requested bytes are not measured physical traffic. Neither screen adopts a model route.

model_hash_policy: Full model digests at preparation and after final process; inode,size,mtime,ctime and inventory guards before/after every process.
retention: Keep individual first/subsequent samples,paired work/route/ownership/fault checks and decisions. Retire normal output/JIT after closure; no full API trace or tensors.
